description.en: Loads an animated camera (a camera motion file, often inside a .pck archive: "archive.pck|file.xv") as a new object and returns its handle. Wait for it with WaitLoading, make it the active camera with CMND_PUSH_CAMERA, play its animation with CMND_SET_MOTION(hCamera, "01", ...) and delete it with CMND_DELETE_CAMERA.

Handle of the camera object.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: A camera animation for a match scene (real usage, from ev44010001.nut; the Shift-JIS object names are replaced by variables here)
